groups.8: Application for registration under section 9(4) FIM/FI/TI.

items.title: Presentation by M/s Crystal Crop Protection Ltd., for grant of registration for technical import of 6-Benzylaminopurine technical 99% w/w min. u/s 9(3) TI (New Source) The representatives of the applicant M/s Crystal Crop Protection Ltd. made a presentation before the RC and submitted that they complied with the guidelines of TI new source and had submitted the requisite data on all the parameters as per the extant guidelines and thus their application qualify for the grant of registration.
items.decision: RC after hearing the submission of the applicant observes that the submission so made are required to be verified from the records available at the Sectt. of CIB&RC. RC decided to approve the same subject to the verification of the genuineness of the submission made by the applicant as per the records available at Sectt. of CIB&RC.

items.title: Presentation by M/s Mahamaya Lifesciences Ltd., for grant of registration for technical import of Flonicamid technical 96% w/w min. u/s 9(3) TI (new source). The applicant made a presentation before the RC and submitted that the captioned application was submitted for the above product in terms of the extant guidelines of TI new source. The application was scrutinized by the RC by all the disciplines and each and every deficiency raised was duly responded to the satisfaction of the RC. The rejection of the above application by the RC in its 463rd meeting at agenda item no. 10.11 was on the ground that the technical of the product is not registered and hence the application is not maintainable. Challenging this decision before the Hon’ble Appellate Authority the Hon’ble Authority was pleased to set-aside the decision impugned in the matter and had made certain observation that the RC had already granted several registrations under TI new source in similar cases where the technical was not registered. Further, the Appellate Authority also observed that there is no explicit mention in the guidelines of TI new source presaging that the technical should be mandatorily registered before consideration of the application under TI new source. The applicant has thus requested to grant the registration for the above product under TI new source. RC was of the view that the applicant should submit the required information w.r.t. the detailed chemical composition of the source registered in the country of origin etc. and decided to grant the registration to the captioned product subject to the submission of requisite information. Secretariat of CIB&RC was instructed to verify the same before the issuance of certificate of registration.

Presentation by M/s Mahamaya Lifesciences Ltd., for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture for export of Cymoxanil 8% + Folpet 64% WP u/s 9(3). Minutes of 468th RC meeting held on 12.01.2026
items.decision: RC decided to withdraw this agenda as the applicant was not having any clarity on the issue. RC grants liberty to the applicant to make a presentation in the next RC meeting if he so desires.

items.title: Confirmation of Data Verification/Generation by concerned institutes/labs submitted along with the application for registration of insecticides.
items.decision: RC perused the agenda and expressed its serious concern about the submission of fake and fabricated reports of the institutes/labs by some of the applicants with an intent to deceive the RC and to obtained wrongful gain in obtaining the registrations based on this fake data/reports. RC directs the Secretariat to take all necessary steps for strong legal action against such applicants, along with the verification of such data/information/reports in such manner as may be appropriate so that the genuineness and veracity of the same should be established.

items.title: Consideration of proforma/template for scrutiny of application under various categories of the Insecticides Act, 1968 for speeding-up of scrutiny process.
items.decision: The RC perused the agenda and deliberated the same in details and appreciated the vision and subsequent efforts put by the Sectt. of CIB&RC for devising the templates, spelling out the technical information extracted from the data in addition to the data submitted by the applicant as per the applicable guidelines to be furnished by the applicants w.r.t Chemistry, Toxicology, Bioassay and Packaging in order to facilitate the Sectt. of CIB&RC for speedy examination of applications under various categories of registration within the stipulated time as provided under the statute. The draft templates are annexed as Annexure-3.2.1. RC also directed that the approved draft templates developed by the Sectt. of CIB&RC shall be kept on public domain for inviting suggestions of the stakeholders within a period of 30 days from the date of hosting of the minutes. The Sectt. of CIB&RC is also directed to issue a public notice to this effect. The comments/inputs/suggestion so received shall be analyzed and the same may be placed before the RC for appropriate decision and implementation.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s Syngenta India Ltd., for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Trinexapac ethyl 25.5% EC under section 9(3) FIM.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved for grant of registration of Trinexapac ethyl 25.5% EC for use as PGR to prevent lodging of Transplanted rice crop subject to MRL fixation on transplanted rice crop. This product shelf life of one and a half years, as 24- months stability data were submitted by the applicant.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s Chemley Agritech Pvt. Ltd., for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Chlorantraniliprole 6% + Indoxacarb 7.25 + Emamectin benzoate 2.5% SC under section 9(3) FIM.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved the grant of registration of Chlorantraniliprole 6% + Indoxacarb 7.25 + Emamectin benzoate 2.5% SC for the control of thrips, fruit borer and tobacco caterpillar on chilli crop only. Subject to the fixation of MRL and to submission of a revised chemical composition specifying the active and inactive isomers of Indoxacarb separately on Form-I, NJSP and L/Ls, as the Chemical composition currently reflects only the total Indoxacarb content of 7.25%.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s JU Agrisciences Pvt. Ltd., for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Chlorothalonil 35% + Cymoxanil 15% + Metalaxyl 2% SC under section 9(3) FIM.

In case the original affidavit is already submitted, then the applicant is required to email the copy of the acknowledgement, within 15 days from the uploading of the minutes to reconcile, afterwards, no such request shall be entertained to issue the CR. It was also directed to strictly follow Gazette Notification SO 3951 (E) dated 08.08.2018 published on 09.08.2018 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, while issuing approvals.

items.title: Consideration of application for 9(4) FIM u/s 9(4).
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and decided as per Annexure –8.48.1 In case of satisfactory cases, CRs shall be issued only after KYC compliance of the applicant account and submission of the original affidavit, as per the format provided in 439th RC, by the applicant, duly forwarded by the authorized signatory only, within 15 days from the uploading of the minutes. In case the original affidavit is already submitted, then the applicant is required to email the copy of the acknowledgement, within 15 days from the uploading of the minutes to reconcile, afterwards, no such request shall be entertained to issue the CR. It was also directed to strictly follow Gazette Notification SO 3951 (E) dated 08.08.2018 published on 09.08.2018 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, while issuing approvals.

items.title: Non verification of registration certificate of M/s Meghmani Industries Ltd. Ahmedabad
items.decision: RC perused the agenda and expressed its serious concern on the issue of possessing of forged/fake certificate of registration for Sulphur 80% WDG purported to be issued vide Registration No. CIR-69,758/2005(254)-Sulphur (WDG-1125) from F.No.1,372-F 9(4)/2005 by M/s. Meghmani Industries Ltd., Ahmedabad. The issue came to light when the company moved an application for the attestation of this certificate of registration and on being inquired about the genuineness of the same from available records at Sectt. of CIB&RC it was revealed that the above file no. doesn’t pertain to any such application for the grant of registration submitted by the M/s. Meghmani Industries Ltd., Ahmedabad. Further the CR records that the above registration was approved by the RC in its 254th meeting on the contrary no such approval was found in the entire MOM of 254th meeting. Prima-facie RC is of the view that M/s. Meghmani Industries Ltd., Ahmedabad is utilizing the above-mentioned CR which apparently appears to be fake and forged and, in any event, couldn’t be presumed as genuine. Such type of illegal activities is to be checked at the threshold with exemplary punishments to the wrong doers. RC still is inclined to grant an opportunity to show cause M/s. Meghmani Industries Ltd., Ahmedabad before taking any further view in the matter. RC directs the Sectt. of CIB&RC to call M/s. Meghmani Industries Ltd., Ahmedabad to submit their point of view on the above aspect in the next RC.

items.title: Submission of fake document/test report by M/s Sunshine Fine Chemsol (I) Pvt. Ltd.
items.decision: RC perused the agenda and took a serious note of the illegal activity of submission of fake and fabricated documents submitted by M/s Sunshine Fine Chemsol (I) Pvt. Ltd. for obtaining the registration. RC also observes that such an act by the company clearly tantamount to play fraud upon the RC, a statutory body constituted under the Insecticides Act, 1968. Such action also amounts to compromise with the safety and efficacy of the insecticide sought to be registered. Submission of forged reports without actual analysis/tests clearly amounts to defraud the authority which is a grave offence clearly covered within the definition of cheating, forgery and playing fraud upon the regulatory authority which may attract serious penal consequences including black listing of the company for future registration and cancellation of the earlier registrations granted along with other legal actions in accordance with law. RC also observed that a Show Cause Notice dated 03.12.2025 had already been issued to the company to provide their clarification/stand in this regard on which the company had sought time to submit the same. RC observes that although the issue is extremely serious but RC feels expedient that a final opportunity may be given to the company to Show Cause as to why legal proceedings may not be initiated against them. RC decided that M/s Sunshine Fine Chemsol (I) Pvt. Ltd. is granted fifteen days time from the communication of this decision to submit their explanation with supporting documents in this regard failing which appropriate legal proceedings/action both in civil and criminal side shall be initiated against the company.

items.title: Representation with a request for action against Chinese company engaged in malpractices leading to illegal import. Minutes of 468th RC meeting held on 12.01.2026
items.decision: RC perused the email communication dated 29.05.2025 received from Mr. Amit Sahni advocate addressed to Chairman RC with a request to take action against Chinese companies engaged frequently in malpractices leading to illegal imports and obtaining product registration in India which is an issue of public interest. It is also inter-alia pointed out that several Chinese companies post registration alter their manufacturing process, shift or close down their approved facilities and continue exporting the product to India from different unapproved sources often without updating the regulatory bodies. This not only undermines the integrity of the regulatory framework but also poses serious risks to Indian manufacturers, consumers and farmers, as the imported products are not re- evaluated for safety or efficacy. The advocate had thus requested that being a serious matter appropriate steps be taken against the violators to curb such practices that compromise regulatory integrity endanger public safety. RC is of the firm view that the concerns raised are serious in nature and needs examination at the level of Sectt. of CIB&RC. RC directs the concerned technical experts dealing import registration and further the issues related to the source of import etc. to examine the entire gamut of issue raised and ensure to place a factual report before the next RC meeting for taking an appropriate view in the matter.

items.title: Judgement dated 19.11.2025 passed by the Hon’ble High Court of Gujarat at Ahmedabad in SCA No. 9705 of 2023 M/s Apcotex Industries Ltd., vs UOI & others with connected matter.
items.decision: RC perused the judgement dated 19.11.2025 passed by the Hon’ble High Court of Gujarat in the above matters wherein the public notice dated 17.02.2022 has been set-aside to the extent of importing acrylonitrile for non-insecticidal use mainly on the ground that there is no requirement laid down in the rules or notification issued by the Central Government. RC decided to comply with the order dated 19.11.2025. RC also observes that the Central Government (DA&FW), after legal opinion and scrutiny, had published draft rules for the requirement of the import permit for all insecticides proposed to be used for non- insecticidal/industrial purposes. RC recalls that similar issues were also dealt in its 395th, 397th, 400th and 401st meetings. RC also notes that the import permits are being granted as per simplified guidelines and as an exemption for registration when the use of such substances is non insecticidal. RC is also of the view that the DGFT Ministry of Commerce can issue a notification for its import and export policies by the virtue of Section 5 of the Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992. RC decided that DA&FW may be requested to issue a suitable communication to the DGFT to issue a notification for the requirement of the import permit for all substances which are proposed to be imported for non-insecticidal use. RC directs the Sectt. of CIB&RC to issue a suitable communication to DA&FW along with the list of all such substances which are to be used for non-insecticidal purposes.

RC recalls its decisions taken in its 420th, 422nd, 424th, 425th meeting and various public notices dated 10.02.2021, 07.11.2022, 06.01.2023, 15.03.2023, 24.07.2023, 03.01.2024 and 13.06.2024 issued on the implementation of KYC guidelines, since many of the applicants had not complied with the KYC requirements and in consequence thereof the CRs of such companies were treated as cancelled. Recently, the RC had written a communication dated 16.10.2025 for cancellation of the manufacturing licenses of all such applicants to respective state agriculture departments who had failed to adhere to the KYC guidelines. RC also noted that a communication have been sent to DA&FW for issuance of Gazette Notification for effecting of cancellation of CR. The RC was apprised Minutes of 468th RC meeting held on 12.01.2026 that lot of representations are received at DA&FW and Sectt.
items.decision: of CIB&RC wherein, the applicants are stating that they were not aware of the multiples account of the companies as the same would have been done by the consultants hired by them for the purpose and therefore, such harsh action taken should be withdrawn and an opportunity must be given for getting the multiples account merged and activating the frozen accounts. RC also observed that certain appeal is also filed before the Hon’ble Appellate Authority under section 10 of the Insecticides Act against the directions/communication dated 16.10.2025 issued to the State Governments by the Sectt. of CIB&RC. RC also observes that a Writ Petition has also been filed before the Hon’ble High Court of Gujarat on similar issues by M/s Agro Chemicals Manufacturers Association of India and other versus Union of India and Others. Although RC is of the view that ample opportunities by the way of various public notices had already been provided but since the applicants are insisting to provide one last opportunity to rectify their mistakes and therefore RC is of the view that a last opportunity may be given to the applicants to represent their respective cases with adequate justification within 30 days from the date of hoisting of this decision. Further the Sectt. of CIB&RC shall also communicate the same to all the concerned applicants on their email addresses with a copy to the respective State Governments to serve this decision upon them. RC also directs the concerned technical expert dealing with the KYC issues to examine the requests so received on its individual merits under the supervision of Sr. Law Officer so as to take a considered view in the matter at the level of Sectt. of CIB&RC. The Secretary, CIB&RC will be authorized for accepting/approving or otherwise of the requests so received from the applicants. The post-facto approval of the RC on such cases will be obtained. RC is also of the considered opinion that till a final view on the issue is arrived at, the implementation of the communication dated 16.10.2025 issued by the Sectt. of CIB&RC to the State Governments shall be kept in abeyance and shall not be given effect to. Appropriate communication in this regard shall be issued to all the State Governments by the Sectt. of CIB&RC for its immediate compliance. RC also decided that DA&FW and our Learned Government Counsel at Hon’ble Gujarat High Court may also be apprised of this decision.

items.title: Illegal trade of Methyl Bromide causing serious damage to Ozone layer and tax evasion to the Government of India and State Government.
items.decision: RC perused the agenda and observed that an email communication dated 14.11.2025 and 03.12.2025 addressed to various Authorities including Sr. officers of DA&FW, PPA and Secretary, CIB&RC has been received from Green Envir pointing out the illegal trade and other unethical activities carried out by M/s Intech Organics Ltd.,/Intech Pharma ltd., who is manufacturing methyl bromide and vinyl bromide along with other products in Rajasthan and Goa inter-alia it has also been pointed out that the firm has exported a consignment of methyl bromide to Libya in the name of vinyl bromide which was caught and thus it is an illegal trade. It is also alleged that the firm is selling methyl bromide in the name of vinyl bromide and exporting it to the countries like Libya although the same is banned in Libya. It is also pointed out that they do not have any facilities/infrastructure Minutes of 468th RC meeting held on 12.01.2026 to produce vinyl bromide in any of their plants. Some more instances of unethical activities carried out by the firm M/s Intech are also pointed out. RC observes that the issues raised in the communication are extremely sensitive as the product methyl bromide has a direct impact on the environment and is capable of causing damage to the Ozone layer. RC took a serious view on such unethical activities carried out by M/s Intech and the same appears to be a breach/violation of the laws of the land. RC feels it expedient that before taking any coercive steps against M/s Intech an opportunity to Show Cause may be granted to them to seek their clarification/justification in this regard. RC directs the Sectt. of CIB&RC to issue a Show Cause Notice to the firm granting them 15 days time to submit a response thereto.
